name: Aquafish
problem: Traditional aquaculture relies on manual sampling and intuitive feeding, leading to 30% feed wastage and delayed disease detection.
solution: A distributed Edge AI system using Raspberry Pi 5 + YOLOv8 for real-time fish detection, biomass estimation, and FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) optimization.
architecture: Edge: Raspberry Pi 5 + USB Webcam (Field Node)
Vision: Custom YOLOv8 (Fish vs Non-Fish logic)
challenges: Bubble & noise filtering in underwater footage.
Stream IP management for isolated farm data.
Cost-constrained hardware design for small farmers.
improvements: Integrate 'Fish Detection Restart' background subtraction logic.
significance: Deployed field-tested system. Not just a model—a complete farm management pipeline from edge capture to admin analytics.

name: ByteSeal
problem: Cloud-based password managers lack verifiable local ownership. Users need a fortress that lives offline.
solution: A production-grade Android vault (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) using AES-GCM (CryptoJS) for strict local encryption and biometric authentication.
challenges: Implementing secure autofill context in Chrome.
Migrating from Vault MVP to production architecture.
Handling large file encryption with memory constraints.
significance: A security-first product philosophy. 'Evidence packs' and zero-knowledge architecture prove you own your data.

name: Sayas OCR
problem: Manual Aadhaar/ID entry for cooperatives is slow, error-prone, and creates data bottlenecks.
solution: A WhatsApp-native OCR pipeline that intercepts document photos, extracts structured data (Name, DOB, Address), and syncs to a MongoDB backend.
challenges: Parsing varied address formats from OCR text.
Handling glare and blur in field-uploaded photos.
significance: Production-ready automation. Solves a real business problem (KYC latency) using the interface users already know (WhatsApp).

name: MediaMTX Infra
problem: Standard RTSP streams have high latency (5-10s), making real-time remote drone/camera control impossible.
solution: A custom EC2-hosted MediaMTX server pipeline converting RTMP/RTSP to WebRTC for sub-500ms latency availability via public IP.
challenges: Configuring UDP hole punching for WebRTC.
Balancing quality vs latency on 4G networks.
significance: The backbone of the Aquafish real-time feed. Demonstrates cloud infrastructure and networking competence.

name: Pro Annotator
problem: Existing annotation tools were either expensive (Roboflow) or clunky (LabelImg) for rapid custom workflows.
solution: A Python/Tkinter GUI built for speed: Zoom-to-cursor, auto-save, dynamic class management, and one-click data.yaml generation.
challenges: Implementing smooth pan/zoom math on Canvas.
Handling large directories without UI freeze.
significance: Developer Experience (DX) tool. Shows ability to build internal tools to accelerate ML workflows.

name: AI Health Coach
problem: Generic health apps lack context-aware advice. Coaching requires parsing complex user history and preferences.
solution: A Flutter (Material 3) app integrating Gemini API for personalized health responses, backed by Firebase Auth and Firestore.
challenges: Structuring prompts to prevent medical hallucinations.
Managing chat state and history persistence.
significance: Modern mobile development + LLM integration. A complete product architecture from verify to chat.

name: Crowd Flow
problem: Retail and public spaces lack granular data on queue lengths and entry/exit flows.
solution: A custom YOLOv8 + DeepSORT pipeline for tracking entities, estimating queue wait times, and analyzing dwell time in ROIs.
challenges: Maintaining ID consistency across frame drops.
improvements: Azure IoT scaling for multi-camera streams.
significance: Applied research into behavioral analytics. Moves beyond simple counting to 'time-spent' and 'flow' metrics.

name: Genesis-AI
problem: Dependence on pre-trained black-box LLMs limits true scientific discovery and hypothesis generation.
solution: A conceptual 'Artificial Scientist' framework designed for recursive self-modification and hypothesis generation without reliance on paid APIs.
challenges: Defining specific 'physics' constraints for the agent.
significance: Use this to show *how* you think. It's not a tool, it's a blueprint for an autonomous engineer.
